description: This file defines an abstract Android activity class named CameraActivity that manages camera permissions, selects the appropriate camera (Camera1 or Camera2 API), handles camera lifecycle, and processes camera frames for use in machine learning inference. It utilizes both the Android camera APIs and TensorFlow objects for image processing, providing a base class for camera-based AI applications.

classes.name: CameraActivity
classes.description: An abstract base class for camera-based activities in an Android app supporting both Camera1 and Camera2 APIs, handling permission management, camera setup, frame processing, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for camera permissions, and sets up the camera fragment.

methods.name: onPreviewFrame
methods.description: Callback for Camera1 API frames; converts YUV to RGB and triggers processing.

methods.name: onImageAvailable
methods.description: Callback for Camera2 API frames; extracts image planes, converts to RGB, and triggers processing.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up background thread for inference.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Shuts down background thread on pause.

methods.name: runInBackground
methods.description: Runs a given runnable on the background thread.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request responses, sets up camera fragment if granted.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if necessary permissions are granted.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests necessary camera and storage permissions.

methods.name: isHardwareLevelSupported
methods.description: Checks if the camera hardware level supports the full API.

methods.name: chooseCamera
methods.description: Selects an appropriate camera ID based on hardware capabilities and preferences.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Sets up the camera fragment based on camera support (Camera1 or Camera2 API).

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills YUV byte arrays from image planes.

methods.name: onPreviewSizeChosen
methods.description: Abstract method; invoked when camera preview size is determined.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Abstract method; returns layout resource ID.

methods.name: getDesiredPreviewFrameSize
methods.description: Abstract method; returns desired frame size.
